In `Aggregate.resolve_expression()` (django/db/models/aggregates.py), when `default` is given the aggregate is wrapped in a `Coalesce` — but the wrapper lost the `is_summary=True` flag that `aggregate()` sets on the aggregate. coalesce = Coalesce(c, default, output_field=c._output_field_or_none)
